findings.summary: PlanController.test.ts is missing test coverage for the ConflictException error branch in recordDecision (when recordPlanDecision returns 'conflict-detected').
findings.suggested_fix: Add a test in the recordDecision describe block verifying that a ConflictException is thrown when the underlying recordPlanDecision call returns { kind: "conflict-detected" }.

findings.summary: PlanController.test.ts is missing test coverage for the NotFoundException error branch in recordDecision when the plan is not found.
findings.suggested_fix: Add a test in the recordDecision describe block verifying that a NotFoundException is thrown when the underlying recordPlanDecision call returns { kind: "not-found" }.

findings.summary: PlanController.test.ts is missing test coverage for the ConflictException error branch in approvePlan.
findings.suggested_fix: Add a test in the approvePlan describe block verifying that a ConflictException is thrown when approvePlanExit throws a PlanExitApprovalError that does not contain "not found" in its message.
